# Allowlisted govulncheck OSV IDs, one per line. Blank lines and lines
# starting with # are ignored. Every entry needs a reason above it, and an
# entry should be removed as soon as the dependency can be bumped instead.
#
# The ci workflow runs the symbol scan (`govulncheck ./...`), so a finding
# here means our code actually reaches the vulnerable function. Prefer fixing
# to allowlisting.
